verdict.rationale: SigNoz supports user-defined alert rules on log patterns, counts, or attribute values, and alerts can be seeded from dashboard panels. These rules trigger notifications, and alerts can be managed by AI agents through Agent Skills and MCP. The only automatic action evidenced is notification; there is nothing on broader event-driven automation. Missing for 10: evidence of actions beyond notifications (webhooks, automated remediation, workflow triggers), documented notification channels and routing, alert rules on metrics and traces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
